_doc: H3 candidate roster (PROPOSAL-h §2 H3) -- the cycle-3/4 roster plus candidates, screened for INTRINSIC balance on the Qwen apparatus. The cycle-3/4 pairs were order-counterbalanced but never identity-screened; the 2026-08-19 finding (bias is token identity, which order counterbalancing cannot absorb) makes this mandatory before e2b.
